rca_of_the_issue: Previous snap-back was caused by frontend sorted memo re-sorting by stale sort_order after optimistic drag. The current fix updates local sort_order before render and backend persistence matches it. Previous archive-toast lag was caused by waiting for PATCH completion; the current fix shows toast immediately and rolls back only on failure. Verification included an artificial 2.5s PATCH delay to prove the toast is no longer gated by network latency.
